policy.catalog: 43 product skills: 41 source-derived knowledge owners plus rust-workflow and rust-verify.
policy.adaptation: Source material is comparative evidence. Product profiles are reorganized around one decision owner, host-neutral workflows, and progressive disclosure rather than copied wholesale.
policy.runtime: Source corpora are not required at plugin runtime. This inventory is provenance and coverage evidence.
